items.summary: Investigate and fix the data loss issue in the backend where all previously uploaded videos were deleted/lost after deploying Version 35. Ensure the stable variable declarations and upgrade/downgrade hooks in main.mo correctly preserve video metadata and associated data (comments, likes, ratings, view counts, thumbnails) across canister upgrades.

Audit and fix the migration.mo upgrade logic to ensure it does not accidentally reset or drop the videos, photos, comments, likes, ratings, or any other stable state when migrating from the old schema to the new schema (adding razorpayConfig and adSenseConfig fields). The migration must only add new fields and must not touch existing collections.

Display a user-facing notice on the Home page and Video Gallery page informing users that a technical issue occurred during the latest update and that video restoration is in progress, to be removed once data is confirmed restored.
